At , "Our guest was the popular educator Khan Sir. In this conversation, Khan Sir discussed who he holds responsible for the poor education system in Bihar and addressed speculations about him entering politics and contesting elections. He also raised some questions about the working style of Prime Minister Modi, his advisors, and officials. What did Khan Sir have to say about the demands of students protesting from Patna to Delhi on various issues, including paper leaks and exam irregularities?"
